entities.summary: Marriott-Slaterville is a city in Weber County, Utah, United States. The population was 2,135 at the 2020 census. It is part of the Ogden–Clearfield, Utah Metropolitan Statistical Area. The city was incorporated in July 1999, in a merger of the previously unincorporated communities of Marriott and Slaterville.
